result.question: Quais hospitais com mais de 5000 internacoes tem custo medio e taxa de mortalidade acima da media geral?
result.gold_sql: WITH por_hospital AS (SELECT i."CNES", COALESCE(h."NO_HOSPITAL", 'Sem nome cadastrado') AS hospital, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, AVG(i."VAL_TOT") AS custo_medio, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM internacoes i JOIN hospital h ON i."CNES" = h."CNES" WHERE i."VAL_TOT" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i."CNES", h."NO_HOSPITAL" HAVING COUNT(*) > 5000), medias AS (SELECT AVG("VAL_TOT") AS custo_medio_geral, SUM(CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS taxa_mortalidade_geral FROM internacoes WHERE "VAL_TOT" IS NOT NULL) SELECT p."CNES", p.hospital, p.total_internacoes, ROUND(p.custo_medio, 2) AS custo_medio, ROUND(p.taxa_mortalidade, 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM por_hospital p, medias m WHERE p.custo_medio > m.custo_medio_geral AND p.taxa_mortalidade > m.taxa_mortalidade_geral ORDER BY p.taxa_mortalidade DESC LIMIT 10;
result.generated_sql: WITH hospital_internacoes AS ( SELECT i."CNES", COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes FROM internacoes i GROUP BY i."CNES" HAVING COUNT(*) > 5000 ), media_taxa AS ( SELECT SUM(total_mortes) * 100.0 / SUM(total_internacoes) AS taxa_media FROM hospital_internacoes ) SELECT hi."CNES", ROUND(AVG(i."VAL_TOT"), 2) AS custo_medio, ROUND(hi.total_mortes * 100.0 / hi.total_internacoes, 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM hospital_internacoes hi JOIN internacoes i ON hi."CNES" = i."CNES" GROUP BY hi."CNES", hi.total_internacoes, hi.total_mortes HAVING ROUND(hi.total_mortes * 100.0 / hi.total_internacoes, 2) > (SELECT taxa_media FROM media_taxa);
